Bug_Title: Assertion methods should not be used within the try block of a try-catch catching an Error
Bug_Explanation: An assertion method is used within the try block of a try-catch that catches an AssertionError. Since the AssertionError is caught, the assertion will never fail.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method in the BuggyAssertion class, which contains a bug where an assertion methods is used within a try-catch block that catches an AssertionError. Since the AssertionError is caught, the assertion will never fail, triggering the bug.
